name: bq-double-tax-relief
description: Analyse 2026 double-tax relief for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. Use for the European Netherlands arrangement, residence, permanent establishments, employment, dividends, pensions and unilateral income-tax relief. Separates taxing rights from domestic liability, exemption from credit, and tax from social insurance. Includes primary decrees, current authority guidance, conditional calculations, evidence controls and carry-forward decisions. This source-cited draft holds other bilateral instruments, actual relief forms, complex residence, foreign-law eligibility, rounding and operational cases. Load with the universal workflow base and applicable BES income, corporate and payroll companions; professional review remains required before reliance.
